summary: PR-001 is resolved: every Vitest project replaces inherited database settings before test modules load, and the Playwright runtime clears inherited Turso credentials before dynamic application imports.
evidence: vitest.config.ts applies test/support/database-isolation.setup.ts before imports in all eight Vitest projects and supplies a harmless unique synthetic inherited URL/token sentinel.

test/support/database-isolation.setup.ts creates one unique os.tmpdir()/mkdtemp local database per test setup, publishes only that URL, deletes TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN, and recursively removes only its created directory after the test file.

test/integration/database-import-isolation.test.ts statically imports caseStore after setup, proves the synthetic inherited URL/token were replaced, runs the import-initialized store, and verifies the sentinel file remains untouched while the disposable database exists.

test/integration/support-http-context.test.ts, test/contract/support-api.contract.test.ts, and test/integration/support-api.characterization.test.ts all passed with their static application imports under the new pre-import isolation.
test/e2e/local-demo.spec.ts deletes TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN after selecting its unique local database and before dynamic Mastra imports.

findings.resolution: Import-time CaseStore schema initialization and route list reads run only against an isolated local test database; inherited remote credentials are removed before application imports.

command_counts.quality: backend/web lint, backend/web typecheck, and format checks passed
